title: Improving Matrix Exponential for Generative AI Flows: A Taylor-Based Approach Beyond Paterson--Stockmeyer
abstract: arXiv:2512.20777v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The matrix exponential is a fundamental operator in scientific computing and system simulation, with applications ranging from control theory and quantum mechanics to modern generative machine learning. While Pad\'e approximants combined with scaling and squaring have long served as the standard, recent Taylor-based methods, which utilize polynomial evaluation schemes that surpass the classical Paterson--Stockmeyer technique, offer superior accuracy and reduced computational complexity. This paper presents an optimized Taylor-based algorithm for the matrix exponential, specifically designed for the high-throughput requirements of generative AI flows. We provide a rigorous error analysis and develop a dynamic selection strategy for the Taylor order and scaling factor to minimize computational effort under a prescribed error tolerance. translated_title: 改进面向生成式AI流的矩阵指数计算：一种超越Paterson–Stockmeyer的基于泰勒展开的方法
translated_abstract: 矩阵指数是科学计算与系统仿真中的一个基本算子，其应用涵盖从控制理论、量子力学到现代生成式机器学习等多个领域。尽管结合缩放平分法的Padé逼近长期以来一直是标准方法，但近期基于泰勒展开的方法利用了超越经典Paterson–Stockmeyer技术的多项式求值方案，能够提供更高的精度和更低的计算复杂度。本文提出了一种优化的基于泰勒展开的矩阵指数算法，专门针对生成式AI流的高吞吐量需求而设计。我们给出了严格的误差分析，并开发了一种针对泰勒阶数和缩放因子的动态选择策略，以便在给定误差容限下最小化计算量。大量数值实验表明，我们的方法带来了显著的加速与更（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种超越经典Paterson–Stockmeyer求值方案的优化泰勒矩阵指数算法，通过严格的误差分析和泰勒阶数与缩放因子的动态选择策略，在满足误差容限的前提下显著降低计算量，为生成式AI流带来大幅加速。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an optimized Taylor-based matrix exponential algorithm that surpasses the classical Paterson–Stockmeyer scheme, using rigorous error analysis and dynamic selection of the Taylor order and scaling factor to minimize computational cost and significantly accelerate generative AI flows.
